era: 1857 年生于日内瓦一个显赫的科学世家（祖上多代为博物学家与数学家），本名费迪南·德·索绪尔；少年时即写出《论印欧语元音的原始系统》(1879)——二十出头便以'喉音假说'震动历史比较语言学，直到半个世纪后赫梯文献证实其推演；先后在莱比锡大学与柏林大学求学——新语法学派的重镇；1878 年发表《印欧语元音原始系统研究》；1881 年起在巴黎高等研究院任教十年，培养出梅耶等一代法国语言学家；1891 年回日内瓦大学，1896 年任教授；1907-1911 年三次讲授普通语言学课程——生前不以为意，讲课笔记散乱；1913 年中风口述遗言而逝；1916 年，巴利与薛施蔼根据三位学生的笔记整理出版《普通语言学教程》——一部他本人从未署名的书，却重写了整个学科
era_en: Born 1857 in Geneva into a distinguished scientific family (generations of naturalists and mathematicians), Ferdinand de Saussure; precocious, his Mémoire on the primitive system of Indo-European vowels (1879) shook historical-comparative linguistics at twenty-two — his laryngeal hypothesis confirmed half a century later by the Hittite tablets; schooled at Leipzig and Berlin, strongholds of the neogrammarians; the Mémoire published 1878; from 1881 a decade teaching at the École Pratique des Hautes Études in Paris, training Meillet and a generation of French linguists; back to Geneva in 1891, professor in 1896; the three courses in general linguistics 1907-1911 — heedless in life, notes scattered; died of a stroke in 1913 after dictating farewell letters; in 1916 Bally and Sechehaye, from the notebooks of three students, brought out the Cours de linguistique générale — a book he never signed, which rewrote the discipline
school: 结构主义语言学奠基 / 符号学之源 / 共时语言学 / 日内瓦学派
historical_significance: 现代语言学的立法者：在他之前，语言学是历史语文学——追问词如何从古流变到今；他调转镜头，问'语言此刻如何作为一个系统运作'——共时与历时的分界成了学科的日界线；他给符号下定义：能指与所指的结合，任意而约定俗成——语言由此不是命名事物的清单，而是一张差异关系之网；'语言/言语'之分把社会的语言系统与个人的言说分开——社会学方法论在语言中的精确移植；他在《普通语言学教程》结尾预告了一门更广的科学——符号学——把衣着、礼仪、军事信号都纳入符号的研究；列维-斯特劳斯用它读神话，巴特用它读时装与神话，拉康用它读无意识——结构主义的整个谱系都从这三次日内瓦讲席的笔记里流出
historical_significance_en: The lawgiver of modern linguistics: before him the discipline was historical philology — asking how words flowed from the old to the new; he turned the lens, asking 'how does language work here and now as a system' — the synchronic/diachronic line became the discipline's date line; he defined the sign as the union of signifier and signified, arbitrary yet conventional — language thereby not a nomenclature naming things but a web of differential relations; the langue/parole distinction parting the social system from the individual utterance — sociological method transplanted into language with precision; at the Cours's end he announced a wider science — semiology — taking dress, rites and military signals into the study of the sign; Lévi-Strauss read myths with it, Barthes fashion and myth, Lacan the unconscious — the whole genealogy of structuralism flowing from the notebooks of those three Geneva courses
unique_thinking: 索绪尔的思维内核是'关系先于实体'：语言中没有先在的实词，只有差异——'t' 之所以是 't' 不是因为它内在像什么，而是因为它不像其他字母；第二个内核是'任意性原则'：能指与所指的联系没有自然理由，只有社会约定——由此语言只能是社会的产物而非个人的工具；第三个内核是'系统对个体的优先'：言语可以分析，语言则是一个让言语成为可能的整体——个体行为须以系统为解释归宿；第四个内核是'价值的相对性'：词的价值不来自它的内容而来自它在系统中的位置——法语的 mouton 与英语的 mutton/sheep 之别即证明价值是相对的、系统内的；第五个内核是'共时先于历时'：不先弄清此刻系统的运作，就无从叙述系统的演变——静止的镜头先于运动的历史
unique_thinking_en: Saussure's cognitive core is relation over substance: in language there are no pre-existing terms, only differences — 't' is 't' not for what it inwardly resembles but for not resembling the other letters; the second core is the arbitrariness principle: no natural reason binds signifier to signified, only social convention — language therefore the product of society, not the instrument of individuals; the third, the system's priority to the individual: speech can be analysed, langue is the whole that makes speech possible — individual acts to be explained by recourse to the system; the fourth, the relativity of value: a word's worth not in its content but in its place in the system — French mouton against English mutton/sheep proving value relative and intra-systemic; the fifth, the synchronic before the diachronic: without first grasping how the system works now, its changes cannot be narrated — the still lens before the moving history
civilization_zh: 十九世纪末的欧洲语言学：新语法学派统治着历史比较研究——语音规律无例外的信条把语言学变成严格科学，但整个学科向后看（印欧语、梵语、原始形式）；日内瓦的市民科学与法语学术的双语环境；巴黎的十年（1881-1891）让他处在法国语法研究的心脏——梅耶、格拉蒙皆出其门下；回到日内瓦后与法国学术界渐远，三次普通语言学讲席面对的是稀落的听众；世纪之交的欧洲：索邦的涂尔干正把'社会事实'立为科学的对象——索绪尔'语言是社会事实'的直觉与涂尔干的纲领同呼吸；一战爆发后学术界凋零，1916 年《教程》在战火中的洛桑出版
civilization_en: European linguistics at the century's end: the neogrammarians ruling historical-comparative study — the dogma of sound laws without exception making linguistics a strict science, but the whole discipline looking backward (Indo-European, Sanskrit, primitive forms); Geneva's bilingual world of citizen science and French scholarship; the Paris decade (1881-1891) placing him at the heart of French grammatical study — Meillet and Grammont of his school; back in Geneva drifting from the French academy, the three courses in general linguistics before a thin audience; Europe at the fin de siècle: Durkheim at the Sorbonne establishing the 'social fact' as science's object — Saussure's intuition of language as a social fact breathing the same programme; the academies withering in the Great War, the Cours published in 1916 at Lausanne amid the flames
roles_zh: 语言学家（历史比较语言学的天才少年——二十余岁即以元音系统震动学界）；理论家（《普通语言学教程》的间接作者——学科的重立法者）；符号学之父（预告'符号学'科学的第一人）；日内瓦学派的核心（普通语言学三次讲席的讲授者）；教师（巴黎十年培养出梅耶等整整一代法国语言学家）
roles_en: Linguist (the precocious genius of historical-comparative study — his vowel system shaking the academy at twenty-two); theorist (the indirect author of the Cours — the discipline's re-legislator); father of semiology (the first to announce a science of the sign); core of the Geneva school (teacher of the three courses in general linguistics); teacher (a Paris decade rearing Meillet and a whole generation of French linguists)
key_works: 《论印欧语元音的原始系统》(1879)——喉音假说：半个世纪后被赫梯文献证实的少年天才之作
《普通语言学教程》(1916, 学生据笔记整理)——能指/所指、语言/言语、共时/历时、句段/联想的学科总纲
《普通语言学讲稿》(1907-1911)——三次讲席的原始材料，学生笔记的直接来源
《关于语言现象中的地理变异的思考》——语言变异与系统观念的早期表述
《音节理论札记》—— phoneme 概念形成的中间环节
key_concepts: 能指/所指 signifiant/signifié（符号的两面：声音形象与概念——结合任意而约定俗成）
语言/言语 langue/parole（社会的语言系统与个人的言说行为——系统的优先性）
共时/历时 synchronie/diachronie（系统此刻的运作与系统随时间的演变——研究次序不可颠倒）
差异与价值 différence et valeur（语言中只有差异，价值是系统内位置的产物）
句段关系/联想关系 rapports syntagmatiques/associatifs（线性组合与记忆聚合的两种关系轴）
任意性 l'arbitraire du signe（符号与事物的联系没有自然理由——约定的产物）
符号学 sémiologie（研究符号及其生活规律的科学——语言只是其一部分）
棋局 metaphor（棋子的价值只在棋局中存在——系统的共时性与变化的关系模型）
cross_references: M-SAU-001（任意性原则法——全部符号学推理的公理起点）
M-SAU-002（语言言语二分法——系统对个体的优先性）
M-SAU-003（共时历时切分法——研究次序的方法论立法）
M-SAU-005（差异价值定位法——价值在系统内相对性）

modes.domain_zh: 符号学方法论/能指与所指的联系是任意的、约定俗成的
modes.domain_en: Semiotic methodology / the link between signifier and signified is arbitrary and conventional
modes.definition_zh: 符号学方法论/《普通语言学教程》的第一原理：能指（声音形象）与所指（概念）之间的联系没有自然必然性——'牛'这个概念在法语边界面里用 b-ö-f 作能指，在德语里用 o-k-s——同一个所指配了不同的能指；因此符号的合法性只能来自使用它的共同体的约定，不存在'更正确的名字'；推论是双向的：既有约定就没有论证，要改变一个符号的意义只能改变共同体的用法而非说服个人
modes.definition_en: Semiotic methodology / the first principle of the Cours: no natural necessity binds the signifier (sound-image) to the signified (concept) — the concept 'ox' carried in French by the signifier b-ö-f, in German by o-k-s — one signified, unlike signifiers; a sign's legitimacy can come only from the convention of the community that uses it, and there is no 'truer name'; the inference runs both ways: where there is convention there is no argument, and to change a sign's meaning one must change the community's usage, not persuade an individual
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第一部分第一章：'能指对它所表达的概念来说是任意的'——语言学的出发公理
modes.key_quote_zh: 能指与所指的联系是任意的——牛不叫 b-ö-f 有什么内在理由？约定在先，论证在后。
modes.key_quote_en: The link between signifier and signified is arbitrary — what inward reason makes ox b-ö-f in French? Convention first, argument after.
key_concepts: 声音形象 image acoustique（能指不是物理声音而是心理印迹——可数、可复制、可约定的单位）
the sound-image (the signifier not the physical sound but a psychological imprint — countable, copyable, conventionalisable)
约定 convention（符号的合法性唯一来源——共同体的用法即符号的法律）
convention (the sole source of a sign's legitimacy — the community's usage the sign's law)
反自然命名反拟声 anti-onomatopoeia（拟声词数量稀少且本身已部分约定化——不足以动摇原则）
anti-onomatopoeia (onomatopoeic words few and themselves partly conventional — no动摇ing of the principle)
约定改变机制 change of convention（意义之变只能经共同体用法之变——个人无权单方改名）
change of convention (meaning changes only via the community's usage — no individual may rename alone)
process_zh: 指认所指：先精确写出概念内容——所指不明则任意性无从讨论
寻找变体：跨语言、跨社群找出同一所指的不同能指——一物多名的对照即公理的证词
检验任意性：排除命名中的自然理由（拟声、象形、因果）——确认剩余联系是纯约定
定位约定主体：确认谁有权改约定（共同体的用法而非个人）——干预方案按此设计
process_en: Fix the signified: write the concept's content precisely — with the signified unclear, arbitrariness cannot be discussed
Seek variants: find unlike signifiers for the same signified across languages and communities — the one-thing-many-names contrast as the axiom's witness
Test arbitrariness: rule out natural reasons for the naming (onomatopoeia, likeness, cause) — confirming the remaining link pure convention
Locate the convention's owner: confirm who may change it (the community's usage, not the individual) — design the intervention accordingly
representative_cases_zh: 牛的多语对照：法语 bœuf 与德语 Ochs 表达同一所指——索绪尔以此一举确立任意性公理，禁止一切'词与物有自然联系'的残余幻想
对'命名真理论'的清算：中世纪关于'亚当的命名是否更真'的千年争论被公理终结——不存在比约定更真的名字
Chess 中'象'的走法：棋子名称与其走法毫无自然联系——改变约定即改变价值，索绪尔以此预示符号系统内价值的约定性
representative_cases_en: The ox contrast: French bœuf and German Ochs for one signified — Saussure establishing the arbitrariness axiom at a stroke, banning every lingering fantasy of a natural bond between word and thing
The reckoning with the 'theory of true names': the medieval millennium-long quarrel whether Adam's naming was truer ended by the axiom — no name truer than convention
The chess bishop's move: no natural tie between a piece's name and its moves — convention changed, value changed; Saussure thereby foreshadowing value's conventionality inside the system
modern_applications_zh: 产品设计：图标语义是任意的（关机符号无自然含义）——测试应查用户的约定习得而非'直觉合理性'
组织命名治理：业务域、指标、代码库的名称只要在共同体（团队）内约定清楚即可——停止追求'最贴切的词'
API 设计：参数名任意的判据是约定一致性文档——发现同一概念两处命名不同即是 bug，而非风格问题
modern_applications_en: Product design: icon semantics arbitrary (the power symbol bears no natural meaning) — test the user's learned convention, not 'intuitive reasonableness'
Organisational naming governance: names for business domains, metrics and codebases need only be conventionally clear within the community (the team) — cease chasing the 'fittest word'
API design: the test of arbitrary parameter names is documented convention-consistency — one concept under two names is a bug, not a style issue
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
皮尔士（对照与补充：三分符号系统（像似/指示/象征）——把任意性收纳为象征符号的一种特性）
巴特（后继：把任意性推进到第二级系统——神话层面重新约定的'次级符号学'）

modes.domain_zh: 语言学方法论/区分社会的语言系统与个人的言说行为
modes.domain_en: Linguistic methodology / parting the social language system from individual acts of speech
modes.definition_zh: 语言学方法论/语言现象的三分（语言、言语、语言行为总称）与二分重心：语言（langue）是全体成员共有的社会规约系统，存在于集体的心智中而非任何个人处；言语（parole）是个人的具体言说，含发音、临时创造与个人意志；二者互相界定——言语使语言实现，语言使言语可理解；方法论重心放在语言——因为系统是同质的、可研究的对象，而言语是异质的、不可穷尽的实例
modes.definition_en: Linguistic methodology / the three-part division of speech phenomena (langue, parole, and their totality) with the centre of gravity twofold: langue is the social system of conventions shared by all members, existing in the collective mind and nowhere in any individual; parole is the individual's concrete utterance, holding articulation, improvisation and personal will; each defines the other — speech actualises langue, langue makes speech intelligible; the methodological centre of gravity placed on langue — the system homogeneous and studyable, speech heterogeneous and inexhaustible
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》导言第四、五章：'语言是言语活动的社会部分……是使个人能够理解并被人理解的规约系统'
modes.key_quote_zh: 语言是社会的规约系统，言语是个人对它的执行——研究秩序上，先立系统后看实例，系统的同质性是科学性的前提。
modes.key_quote_en: Langue the social system of conventions, parole the individual's execution of it — in the order of study, the system first and instances after; the system's homogeneity the premise of science.
key_concepts: 系统优先 systemic priority（语言先于且外在于个人——出生即坠入既成的符号秩序）
systemic priority (langue prior to and outside the individual — one born into a finished sign order)
同质性 homogeneity（语言是心智中可界定的规约集——科学对象所需的可重复性）
homogeneity (langue a definable set of conventions in the mind — the repeatability science requires)
实例不可穷尽 inexhaustibility of instances（言语的每次发音都是新事件——个案永远数不完）
inexhaustibility of instances (each utterance a fresh event — anecdotes never counted out)
互倚互成 mutual actualisation（没有语言言语是含混的噪音，没有言语语言是死的清单）
mutual actualisation (without langue speech confused noise, without speech langue a dead inventory)
process_zh: 切分层次：把现象分为'系统的规约'与'个人的执行'两层——先给每层下操作性判据
锁定系统层：识别该领域中被共同体共有的规约集合——语法、礼仪、代码风格、评审标准
择对象：优先研究系统层——其同质性保证结论可重复；实例仅作系统的证据
回填：系统结论用于解释实例——再由反常实例修订系统
process_en: Part the levels: divide the phenomenon into 'the system's conventions' and 'the individual's execution' — operational criteria for each
Fix the system layer: identify the convention set shared by the community — grammar, etiquette, code style, review standards
Choose the object: study the system layer first — its homogeneity guaranteeing repeatability; instances only as evidence of the system
Backfill: use systemic findings to explain instances — and revise the system by aberrant ones
representative_cases_zh: 教程立科的决定性一步：把研究对象从'言说活动'的混沌整体收缩到'语言'——索绪尔自比'从浑水中取一掬清水'，学科对象由此可定义
对个人风格研究的降格：作家用词的独特性被看作言语层的自由，不改变法语系统的规约——个人创造以系统为背景才可理解
发音错误的分析：误读一个词时被纠正的依据不是声音相似而是系统规约——语音批评的凭据在语言层不在言语层
representative_cases_en: The Cours's decisive step: shrinking the object from the chaos of 'speech activity' to langue — Saussure likening it to scooping clear water from the muddy; the discipline's object thereby definable

The demotion of the study of personal style: a writer's singular word-choice as freedom on the parole level, touching no rule of the French system — individual creation intelligible only against the system
The analysis of a mispronunciation: what corrects a mispronounced word is not acoustic likeness but the system's convention — the warrant of phonetic criticism on the langue level, not parole
modern_applications_zh: 代码评审治理：优先把'评审标准'（系统层）写成明文规约，而非逐条纠正个人提交（言语层）——从救火转向立约
客服质检：把'用户误解'归因于品牌词汇系统的约定不明（术语表缺失），而非个人表达失误——改系统不改个例
教育评估：区分'系统知识'（可教的规约）与'现场发挥'（不可教的实例）——考纲设计只考前者
modern_applications_en: Code-review governance: first write the review standards (system level) into explicit conventions rather than correcting individual submissions (parole level) — from firefighting to legislation
Customer-service QA: attribute 'user misunderstanding' to an unclear convention in the brand's lexical system (a missing glossary), not to a personal slip — fix the system, not the instance
Education assessment: separate 'system knowledge' (teachable conventions) from 'improvisation' (unteachable instances) — the syllabus examines the former only
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
乔姆斯基（后继与转折：把'语言能力/语言运用'二分重铸为心理主义版本——系统内置于个人心智）
奥斯汀（对照：以言语行为理论把'言语'重新立为研究对象——言说即行动，另辟一径）

modes.domain_zh: 研究方法论/区分系统此刻的运作与系统随时间的演变
modes.domain_en: Research methodology / parting a system's working now from its change over time
modes.definition_zh: 研究方法论/语言研究必须先切一刀：共时轴（同一时期内语言系统各要素的关系）与历时轴（个别要素随时间的演变）是两条不可混同的轴线；历时的演变是逐项的、局部的（某个音变了，整个系统并没有'变'，而是被打了个洞），共时的状态是系统性的、整体的；方法论的次序律：先共时后历时——不先弄清此刻系统的价值网络，就无法判断一次演变冲击了哪些位置；'语言是形式不是实体'在这一刀之后才可操作
modes.definition_en: Research methodology / language study must first cut once: the synchronic axis (relations among a system's elements within one period) and the diachronic axis (the change of individual elements over time) are two lines not to be confused; diachronic change is item-by-item and local (a sound changes and the system as a whole does not 'change' but is pierced), the synchronic state systemic and total; the methodological rule of order: synchronic before diachronic — without first mapping the present network of values, no judging which positions one change strikes; 'language is form, not substance' workable only after this cut
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第二部分：'语言是一个系统……只有共时态才有整体性与系统性'；'历时事实与它引起的共时事实是两回事'
modes.key_quote_zh: 先切开两条轴：此刻系统的价值网络是一张图，历史演变是一次次打洞——先读图，再谈洞的来历。
modes.key_quote_en: Cut the two axes apart: the present network of values one map, historical change a series of piercings — read the map first, then the holes' history.
key_concepts: 轴线不可通约 incommensurable axes（共时的整体性与历时的局部性是两种性质——历时解释不能冒充共时解释）
incommensurable axes (synchronic totality and diachronic locality two different natures — diachronic explanation cannot pose as synchronic)
打洞模型 the piercing model（演变是系统的局部事件——价值网络在洞周围重新调整）
the piercing model (change a local event in the system — the value network readjusts around the hole)
次序律 rule of order（先共时后历时——研究对象的第一刀决定后续一切）
the rule of order (synchronic first, diachronic after — the first cut determining all the rest)
反进化论叙事 anti-evolutionist narrative（系统不是向'更好'演化——演变的动因在系统外不在系统内）
anti-evolutionist narrative (the system evolves not toward 'the better' — the cause of change outside the system, not within)
process_zh: 切轴：明确研究问题属于共时层还是历时层——'现在如何运作'与'如何变成这样'分开立项
绘共时图：先把当前状态的要素与关系画完整——价值网络是基线
标演变点：在历史序列中定位每次变化的位置与范围——局部事件，不冒充整体变化
联动解释：演变对共时图的冲击在哪里——洞周围的重新调整就是解释的落点
process_en: Cut the axes: settle whether the question belongs to the synchronic or diachronic layer — 'how it works now' and 'how it became so' as separate projects
Draw the synchronic map: complete the elements and relations of the present state first — the value network the baseline
Mark the change points: locate each change in the historical sequence, its position and scope — local events, never posing as total change
Link the explanations: where does the change strike the map — the readjustment around the hole the landing point of explanation
representative_cases_zh: 对 19 世纪语文学的翻转：整代学者只向后看（词源、原始形式），索绪尔把'此刻的法语如何运作'立为第一问题——学科的镜头第一次转到当下
日耳曼语元音交替的处理：Ablaut 在共时层面是形态系统的规则网络，在历时层面是逐音演变——两个层面的事实性质不同，不能互相推导
棋局隐喻的原型用法：用棋子的替换（马车换骑士）说明历时变化只影响局部位置，整盘棋的规则与价值格局仍是共时事实
representative_cases_en: The flip of nineteenth-century philology: a whole generation looking only backward (etymology, primitive forms), Saussure making 'how French works now' the first question — the discipline's lens turned to the present for the first time
The handling of Germanic ablaut: on the synchronic level a network of rules in the morphological system, on the diachronic a per-sound evolution — facts of two kinds, not derivable from each other

The chess metaphor in its prototype: the substitution of a piece (a carriage for a knight) showing that diachronic change touches only a local position, the rules and value-pattern of the whole board remaining synchronic facts
modern_applications_zh: 架构治理：先画'当前系统的模块依赖图'（共时）再谈'重构路线图'（历时）——无基线的重构是盲迁
组织变革：把'现有协作网络的盘点'与'变革路径的设计'分开立项——不要用历史故事解释当下的功能失调
技术债分析：每笔债是历时的'洞'，修复方案须按它对当前依赖图的冲击排序，而非按欠账时间排序
modern_applications_en: Architecture governance: draw the current module-dependency map (synchronic) before the refactoring roadmap (diachronic) — refactorings without a baseline are blind migrations
Organisational change: 'an inventory of the present collaboration network' and 'the design of a change path' as separate projects — no explaining present dysfunction with war stories
Technical-debt analysis: each debt a diachronic 'hole'; fixes ranked by their impact on the current dependency map, not by the age of the owing
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
列维-斯特劳斯（后继：把共时分析推到人类学——神话的结构逻辑先于其历史层积）
布罗代尔（对照：历史学的共时化——'长时段'把结构状态立为历史研究的第一对象，与索绪尔切分法互补）

modes.domain_zh: 系统方法论/整体先于要素，要素由其在整体中的位置定义
modes.domain_en: Systems methodology / the whole prior to its parts, each part defined by its place in the whole
modes.definition_zh: 系统方法论/把研究对象定义为系统而非要素的集合：语言不是名词清单，是一个各部分互相规定的整体——要素没有先在的、孤立的实体，'离开了它在系统中的位置就什么也不是'；因此分析的次序是从整体到要素：先确定系统的边界与总格局，再给要素定位；对照旧法（从要素出发逐个解释再拼合整体），系统整体优先法把'拼装谬误'（以为整体性质可由部分性质相加得到）列为第一禁忌
modes.definition_en: Systems methodology / defining the object of study as a system, not a collection of elements: language not a nomenclature but a whole whose parts determine one another — an element has no prior, isolated substance, 'apart from its place in the system it is nothing'; hence the order of analysis from whole to part: fix the system's boundary and total pattern first, then locate the elements; against the old way (explaining element by element then assembling the whole), the system-first method names the 'fallacy of composition' (supposing the whole's nature the sum of the parts') the first taboo
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第二部分第四章：'语言是一个系统，其中一切部分都同时地、互为条件地存在'——语言不是命名集
modes.key_quote_zh: 整体先于要素：棋子没有棋盘就什么都不是——先定格局，再谈每颗子的意义。
modes.key_quote_en: The whole before the parts: a chessman is nothing without the board — the pattern first, the meaning of each piece after.
key_concepts: 要素相对性 relativity of elements（要素的性质完全来自系统内的对立与位置——没有孤立定义的词）
relativity of elements (an element's nature wholly from its oppositions and position in the system — no word defined in isolation)
边界确定 boundary-fixing（系统的第一步是划界——什么在系统内、什么只是外部噪声）
boundary-fixing (the system's first step the drawing of its border — what is within, what mere outside noise)
拼装谬误 fallacy of composition（部分性质相加不等于整体性质——结构性质只在整体层存在）
the fallacy of composition (the sum of the parts' natures not the whole's — structural properties exist only at the whole's level)
反本义优先 anti-etymological primacy（一个词'本义'不能解释其现行价值——现行价值由现行系统定）
anti-etymological primacy (a word's 'original meaning' cannot explain its present value — set by the present system)
process_zh: 划界：确定系统范围——哪些要素互相规定，哪些只是环境
绘格局：把要素间的对立与互补关系画成整体图——每个要素先看'它与什么相对'
定位要素：要素的身份=它在格局中的位置——拒绝从要素的'内在属性'出发的解释
反查拼装：任何'部分相加'式结论回放整体层检验——解释不通则说明要素定位有误
process_en: Fix the border: set the system's scope — which elements determine one another, which are mere environment
Draw the pattern: the elements' oppositions and complements as one whole map — each element first seen 'against what it opposes'
Locate elements: an element's identity = its place in the pattern — refusing explanations from the element's 'inherent attributes'
Re-test composition: replay any 'sum of parts' conclusion at the whole's level — failure of explanation signals misplaced elements
representative_cases_zh: 对'语言即词汇清单'的否定：传统语法把语言当作按类别排列的命名表，索绪尔以'语言是形式不是实体'重新奠基——词的价值只在差异网络中
法语复数的分析：'复数'不是两个概念相加的标记，而是与单数对立的位置——价值由对立产生而非由内容产生
对词源解释的降格：法语 pas（步）的现代价值与其拉丁词源无关——用历史解释现行用法被点名为范畴错误
representative_cases_en: The denial of 'language as a stock of words': traditional grammar ranking a nomenclature by categories, Saussure re-founding on 'language is form, not substance' — a word's value only in the network of differences
The analysis of the French plural: not the mark of two concepts added but a position opposed to the singular — value from opposition, not content
The demotion of etymological explanation: the modern value of French pas (step) independent of its Latin source — explaining present use by history named a category error
modern_applications_zh: 微服务设计：服务的边界由其在整个业务能力格局中的位置定义——先画全景再拆服务，拒绝按'某个服务自身内聚'孤岛式建模
团队角色设计：岗位职责由组织整体的功能对立关系定义——'每个人做好自己那摊事'的加总不等于组织能力
指标体系：单个 KPI 无意义，先定指标间的对立与制衡关系（速度 vs 质量）——拼装式 OKR 是价值系统未定
modern_applications_en: Microservice design: a service's boundary defined by its place in the whole landscape of business capabilities — the panorama drawn before the split, no island-modelling by 'this service's own cohesion'
Team-role design: a post's duties defined by the organisation's functional oppositions — the sum of 'everyone minding their own plot' is not organisational capability
Metric systems: a lone KPI meaningless; first the oppositions and counterweights among indicators (speed vs quality) — assembled-by-parts OKRs mean the value system was never fixed
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
涂尔干（同源：社会事实不能还原为个体心理——整体层性质独立，两条纲领同构）
贝塔朗菲（后继：一般系统论把'整体大于部分之和'立为跨学科公理——系统思维的科学化收编）

modes.domain_zh: 语言学方法论/价值由差异与位置产生，不由内容产生
modes.domain_en: Linguistic methodology / value born of difference and position, not of content
modes.definition_zh: 语言学方法论/把'价值'（valeur）与'意义'（signification）严格分开：意义是能指与所指的对应，价值是要素在系统中因与邻项的差异而占有的位置——法语的 mouton 一词对应英语的 mutton（肉）与 sheep（动物）两词，所以 mouton 的价值不等于 mutton 也不等于 sheep，而是'英语两词所没有覆盖的整个领地'；由此方法论的判据：确定一个要素的价值，不问'它包含什么'，只问'它与什么相对、它排斥谁、谁与它相邻'——价值永远是否定性的、相对的、系统内的
modes.definition_en: Linguistic methodology / 'value' (valeur) strictly parted from 'meaning' (signification): meaning the correspondence of signifier and signified, value the position an element holds in the system through its difference from its neighbours — French mouton answered in English by two words, mutton (meat) and sheep (animal), so mouton's value equals neither mutton nor sheep but 'the whole territory the two English words do not cover'; the methodological test follows: to fix an element's value ask not 'what does it contain' but 'what does it oppose, whom does it exclude, what adjoins it' — value always negative, relative, intra-systemic
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第二部分第四章：'在语言中只有差异，没有积极的项'——价值与意义的区分
modes.key_quote_zh: 语言中只有差异：法语的 mouton 不等于英语的 mutton 也不等于 sheep——它的价值是两个英语词没盖住的那块地。价值是否定性的。
modes.key_quote_en: In language there are only differences: French mouton equals neither English mutton nor sheep — its value the ground the two English words leave uncovered. Value is negative.
key_concepts: 否定性 negativity（要素的性质由'它不是什么'规定——差异先于同一性）
negativity (an element's nature fixed by 'what it is not' — difference before identity)
价值/意义二分 value vs meaning（意义是纵向对应，价值是横向位置——两问不可混）
value vs meaning (meaning the vertical correspondence, value the horizontal position — two questions not to be mixed)
系统相对性 systemic relativity（同一所指在不同系统中的价值不同——价值不能跨系统直接换算）
systemic relativity (one signified bearing unlike value in unlike systems — value not convertible across systems)
邻项分析 neighbourhood analysis（价值的测绘靠邻项的边界——知道谁与谁相接才知道每块的领域）
neighbourhood analysis (value mapped by the borders of neighbours — knowing who adjoins whom to know each territory)
process_zh: 列邻项：找出与目标要素最接近的一组项——它们的边界就是价值地图
测覆盖：标出每个邻项覆盖的用法领地——重叠与空隙立即显形
定价值：目标要素的价值=它独占的领地（邻项未覆盖的部分）——用否定性语言写出来
跨系统换算检查：如果结论需要把一个系统的价值搬进另一个系统——停下，这是范畴错误
process_en: List the neighbours: the set of items closest to the target — their borders the value map
Measure coverage: mark the territory of usage each neighbour covers — overlaps and gaps at once visible
Fix the value: the target's value = the territory it alone holds (what the neighbours leave uncovered) — written in the language of negation
Check cross-system conversion: if the conclusion needs one system's value carried into another — stop; that is a category error
representative_cases_zh: mouton/sheep 的经典对照：一个所指、两个系统中价值不同——索绪尔用一对词汇把'翻译不是换词而是换价值网络'说尽
时态价值的比较：法语过去时系统与英语时态系统项数不同，每个时态的价值因此不同——逐词对译语法范畴被点名错误
对'同义词'的否定：两个词并存必有价值分工（'恐惧'与'害怕'），完全同义在语言中是暂态——价值由差异维持
representative_cases_en: The classic mouton/sheep contrast: one signified, unlike value in two systems — a single pair of words saying all that translation is not word-swapping but network-swapping

The comparison of tense values: the French past system and the English one holding unlike counts of terms, each tense's value therefore unlike — word-for-word translation of grammatical categories named an error
The denial of 'synonyms': two words coexisting must divide value ('fear' and 'dread'), full synonymy in language a passing state — value maintained by difference
modern_applications_zh: 品牌定位：产品的价值=竞品矩阵中它独占的位置（未覆盖领地）——对标清单法（逐项比较）被换为差异定位法
术语表治理：两个内部术语并存必须划清各自领地——'基本同义'的术语对是价值冲突，迟早引起沟通事故
招聘画像：岗位价值由其在团队技能网络中的空缺定义——不是'优秀人才通用画像'而是'该位置排斥什么、邻接什么'
modern_applications_en: Brand positioning: a product's value = the position it alone holds in the competitor matrix (uncovered ground) — the checklist benchmarking (item-by-item) replaced by differential positioning
Glossary governance: two internal terms coexisting must have their territories parted — 'roughly synonymous' term pairs a conflict of value, sooner or later a communication accident
Hiring profiles: a role's value defined by the vacancy it fills in the team's skill network — not a 'universal portrait of talent' but 'what this position excludes, what it adjoins'
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
雅各布森（后继：把差异原则推到音位学极点——音位的辨义功能全靠对立特征）
列维-斯特劳斯（移植：亲属关系与神话的要素同样由差异与对立定义——结构主义人类学的起点）

modes.domain_zh: 结构分析方法/句段（组合）轴与联想（聚合）轴的双重分析
modes.domain_en: Structural analysis / the double axis of syntagm (combination) and association (selection)
modes.definition_zh: 结构分析方法/语言的一切运作沿两条轴展开：句段轴（in praesentia）——要素在线性序列中的横向组合（'re-lire'的次序关系），联想轴（in absentia）——不在场的要素在记忆中的纵向聚合（由 re-lire 唤起的 lire、légal、répéter 系列）；任何一次言说都是双轴的一次交叉：在组合轴上选择并连接；方法论价值在于：分析一个表达式的效果时，必须同时问'它与前后的项如何连接'（组合关系）与'它替换成什么会不同'（聚合关系）——风格与错位都在两条轴的交叉处显形
modes.definition_en: Structural analysis / all language's workings along two axes: the syntagmatic (in praesentia) — elements' horizontal combination in a linear sequence (the order-relation of re-lire), the associative (in absentia) — the vertical aggregation in memory of absent items (the series lire, légal, répéter evoked by re-lire); every utterance one crossing of the two axes: choosing and linking along the axis of combination; the methodological worth: analysing an expression's effect, ask at once 'how it links to the items before and after' (syntagmatic) and 'what would differ if it were replaced' (paradigmatic) — style and misplacement both appear at the crossing of the axes
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第二部分第五章：句段关系与联想关系——'语言各项间的一切关系都可归入这两类'
modes.key_quote_zh: 两条轴的交叉：横着的是怎么连，竖着的是换成什么——表达的效果在'如何组合'与'别的选择'的交叉点上。
modes.key_quote_en: The crossing of two axes: horizontal, how things link; vertical, what they might be replaced by — an expression's effect at the crossing of 'how combined' and 'what else chosen'.
key_concepts: 在场/不在场 in praesentia / in absentia（句段关系靠前后项的现实连接，联想关系靠记忆中不缺席的系列）
in praesentia / in absentia (the syntagmatic resting on the real linkage of neighbours, the associative on the series held in memory)
线性原则 linearity（能指是一条线——组合轴的展开有先后，不可压缩）
linearity (the signifier a line — the combination axis unfolding in order, incompressible)
替换测试 substitution test（把一个位置换成邻项族的其他成员——表达效果的变化即该位置的函数）
the substitution test (one position swapped for another of the family — the change in effect the function of that position)
聚合/组合互补 paradigm-syntagm complementarity（先选择后组合——两种'秩序'互补生成表达）
paradigm-syntagm complementarity (choose first, then combine — two 'orders' complementary in generating expression)
process_zh: 切组合轴：把对象的表达按线性序列切开——标出每个位置的连接关系（衔接、搭配、次序）
列聚合族：为每个位置列出可替换成员——'这个位置还能放什么'
替换测试：逐位替换并记录效果变化——找到效果的关键承载位置
交叉诊断：问题（或风格）在哪个交叉点上——错位的组合还是错选的成员
process_en: Cut the syntagmatic axis: slice the expression's linear sequence — mark each position's linkage (cohesion, collocation, order)
List the paradigm family: for each position, the replaceable members — 'what else this position could hold'
Run the substitution test: replace position by position and log the change in effect — locating the position that bears the effect
Cross-diagnose: at which crossing is the problem (or the style) — a mis-made combination or a mis-chosen member
representative_cases_zh: 对'表达=词语堆叠'的否定：同一组词换次序效果全变（'法国人喝白酒'与'白酒喝法国人'）——组合关系本身是意义的来源，不是透明的容器
修辞效果的分析：诗歌换一个韵脚（聚合选择）或调一次语序（组合安排）效果迥异——风格被定位在双轴交叉处而非'灵感'
句法教学的原型：从'背规则'转向'每格能填什么族+每族成员如何连接'——语法被表述为双轴的操作说明
representative_cases_en: The denial of 'expression = a heap of words': the same words reordered, all effect changed — the syntagmatic relation itself a source of meaning, not a transparent container

The analysis of rhetorical effect: a poem changes one rhyme (paradigmatic choice) or one word-order (syntagmatic arrangement) and the effect differs utterly — style located at the crossing of the axes, not in 'inspiration'
The prototype of syntax teaching: from 'memorising rules' to 'what family fills each slot, and how family members link' — grammar restated as operating instructions over two axes
modern_applications_zh: 文案 A/B 测试设计：把改动定位到轴上——是换了词（聚合）还是换了序（组合），归因不再混淆
代码可读性审查：命名（聚合轴选择）与语句结构（组合轴安排）分开评审——'读不懂'先诊断在哪条轴
会议发言分析：把发言切成'观点序列'（组合）与'措辞族'（聚合）——说服效果定位到具体交叉点
modern_applications_en: Copy A/B-test design: locate the change on an axis — a swapped word (paradigm) or a swapped order (syntagm); attribution no longer muddled
Code-readability review: naming (paradigmatic choice) and statement structure (syntagmatic arrangement) reviewed apart — 'hard to read' first diagnosed on one axis
Analysis of speech-making: the address cut into 'sequence of points' (syntagm) and 'family of phrasings' (paradigm) — persuasive effect located at a definite crossing
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
雅各布森（后继：把双轴推为'隐喻/转喻'两大修辞极——失语症的双型分析成为经典）
巴特（移植：《写作的零度》用双轴分析写作方式——文学的每一句都是双轴的交叉）

modes.domain_zh: 跨领域方法论/把语言学框架外推到一切符号系统
modes.domain_en: Cross-domain methodology / extrapolating the linguistic framework to all sign systems
modes.definition_zh: 跨领域方法论/《教程》结尾的预告：可以设想一门研究'符号的生命'的科学——符号学（sémiologie），语言学只是它的一部分；仪式、法律、军事信号、时尚、礼仪都是符号系统，与语言同构（能指/所指、约定、差异价值）；方法论程序是双向的：向外推（语言学的分析工具用于非语言系统）与向内借（其他系统的约定性反证语言分析）——外推的合法性判据是'该系统是否具备任意约定与差异结构'，二者缺一即不能套用
modes.definition_en: Cross-domain methodology / the Cours's closing announcement: one may imagine a science studying 'the life of signs' — semiology, of which linguistics is only a part; rites, law, military signals, fashion, etiquette all sign systems isomorphic with language (signifier/signified, convention, differential value); the method runs both ways: outward (linguistics' tools applied to non-linguistic systems) and inward (other systems' conventionality confirming the analysis of language); the licence for extrapolation is 'does the system hold arbitrary convention and differential structure' — lacking either, no application
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》结论部分：'符号学是……研究符号及其生活规律的科学……语言学只是这门一般科学的一部分'
modes.key_quote_zh: 语言只是符号系统中的一种——礼仪、信号、时尚都是符号：能不能套用，先查它有没有任意约定与差异结构。
modes.key_quote_en: Language but one of the sign systems — rites, signals, fashion all signs: before applying the tools, test whether the system holds arbitrary convention and differential structure.
key_concepts: 系统同构 isomorphism（非语言符号系统同样有能指/所指与差异价值——外推的前提）
isomorphism (non-linguistic sign systems likewise holding signifier/signified and differential value — the premise of extrapolation)
合法性判据 the licence test（任意约定+差异结构双条件——满足才可套用语言学工具）
the licence test (the two conditions of arbitrary convention plus differential structure — both met before linguistic tools apply)
双向程序 the two-way procedure（向外推与向内借——外推也反哺原框架的清晰度）
the two-way procedure (extrapolating out, borrowing in — the outward move also refining the original frame)
等级宣称 hierarchy claim（语言学是符号学的范型而非全部——更大科学的第一块模型）
the hierarchy claim (linguistics the model of semiology, not its whole — the first model of a larger science)
process_zh: 验资格：确认目标系统满足双条件——存在任意约定、要素价值靠差异维持
找能指面：在目标系统中辨认声音形象的角色对应物（制服、路标、礼节动作）
套用分析：按能指/所指、组合/聚合、价值定位逐层套用——每层检查是否真的成立
回检边界：套用失败之处标记'该系统与语言的差异'——防止框架殖民
process_en: Test eligibility: confirm the target system meets both conditions — arbitrary convention present, value of elements held by difference
Find the signifier face: in the target system, the counterpart of the sound-image (uniform, road sign, rite-gesture)
Apply the analysis: signifier/signified, combination/selection, value-fixing layer by layer — each layer checked to hold
Re-check the border: mark where application fails as 'this system differs from language' — against framework colonisation
representative_cases_zh: 服饰符号的预演：索绪尔点名'时装即符号系统'——衣着的能指（款式）与所指（社会身份）靠约定与差异维系，预告了巴特《时装体系》
军号信号的分析：同一军号在'进攻/撤退'中的价值来自与其他信号的差异——没有信号清单意义，只有信号系统
礼仪系统：握手与鞠躬的'意义'不在动作内在性质而在文化系统中的位置——任意约定的非语言样板
representative_cases_en: The rehearsal of dress as signs: Saussure naming fashion outright a sign system — the signifier (cut) and signified (social standing) held by convention and difference, foretelling Barthes's Système de la Mode
The analysis of bugle signals: a call's value in 'advance/retreat' from its difference from other calls — no list of signal meanings, only a signal system
The system of etiquette: the 'meaning' of handshake and bow not in the gestures' inner nature but their place in the culture's system — the non-linguistic model of arbitrary convention
modern_applications_zh: UX 符号设计：图标、色彩、提示音是否构成系统（有约定、有差异）——孤立的'红色按钮'无价值，系统内才有
组织文化解码：把公司仪式（晋升礼、复盘会）当符号系统读——用语言学工具做文化审计
平台治理：把'点赞/转发/举报'作为一组符号行动分析其价值分工——功能重叠即系统冗余
modern_applications_en: UX symbol design: whether icons, colours and alert tones form a system (with convention, with difference) — a lone 'red button' worthless, valuable only within the system
Decoding organisational culture: the company's rites (promotion, retrospective) read as a sign system — linguistic tools turned to cultural audit
Platform governance: 'like/repost/report' analysed as a set of sign-actions and their division of value — overlapping function is systemic redundancy
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
巴特（后继：符号学外推的完成者——神话、时装、脱衣舞都成为符号分析的对象）
列维-斯特劳斯（移植：亲属称谓与神话素作为符号系统——结构主义人类学的立科文书）

modes.domain_zh: 思维工具法/用棋局模型理解系统的共时结构与历时变化
modes.domain_en: Heuristic method / the chess model for a system's synchronic structure and diachronic change
modes.definition_zh: 思维工具法/索绪尔用棋局作为语言系统的分析模型，且反复警告'棋喻只能用到这里'：共时态是棋局当前的局面（每颗子的价值由全局定），历时变化是单颗子的替换或移动（马车换成骑士——材质与名称都换了，位置价值不变；移动一颗骑士——全局价值立刻重排）；此法的深意有三：变化是系统的内在事件而非外部灾难；价值是位置性的（换材质不影响、挪位置全变）；偶然的局部变化会触发全局的重新定价——用模型类比时先验类比边界，是索绪尔方法论自觉的标志
modes.definition_en: Heuristic method / Saussure's chess model for the linguistic system, with the repeated warning 'the metaphor works only so far': the synchronic state the board's present position (each piece's value fixed by the whole), diachronic change the replacement or move of a single piece (a carriage for a knight — material and name both changed, positional value unchanged; a knight moved — the whole board's values at once re-ranked); three deep points: change an internal event of the system, not an external catastrophe; value positional (swap the material, nothing; shift the place, everything); a contingent local change triggering global repricing — testing an analogy's boundary before using it, the mark of Saussure's methodological self-awareness
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《普通语言学教程》第二部分第九章：'棋局的状态与语言的状态相当……不过比喻只能用到这里为止'
modes.key_quote_zh: 棋局只能比到这里：换棋子（马车换骑士）价值不变，挪棋子全局重排——先验类比用到哪一步，再用。
modes.key_quote_en: The chess metaphor only so far: swap a piece (a carriage for a knight) and value holds; move one and the board re-ranks — test where the analogy runs before running it.
key_concepts: 位置价值 positional value（棋子的价值由棋位定，不由棋子的材质定——价值=位置）
positional value (a piece's worth from its square, not its material — value = position)
局部事件全局重排 local event, global re-ranking（一步棋只动一颗子，价值格局却整体重估）
local event, global re-ranking (one move one piece, yet the value-pattern re-estimated whole)
旁观者中立 the observer's neutrality（棋局的每次变化对下棋人同等紧要——系统对演变无偏好）
the observer's neutrality (each move equally consequential to the players — the system indifferent to evolution)
类比边界检验 boundary-testing of analogy（模型类比的合法性须先划定——隐喻是有适用半径的工具）
boundary-testing of analogy (the licence of a model analogy drawn in advance — metaphor a tool with a radius of validity)
process_zh: 建模型：为目标系统找同构模型（棋局、钟表机构、经济市场）——同构性写明在哪几点
划边界：逐点列出模型失效之处——'比喻只能用到这里'写成明文
推演：用模型推理系统行为——位置价值、局部扰动全局重排等推论
回收检验：把推论放回真实系统验证——失效即边界划错了
process_en: Build the model: find an isomorphic model for the target system (chess, clockwork, market) — the isomorphism's points written out
Draw the border: list point by point where the model fails — 'the metaphor works only so far' put in writing
Deduce: reason about the system's behaviour through the model — positional value, local disturbance and global re-ranking
Recycle-test: return the inferences to the real system — failure means the border was drawn wrong
representative_cases_zh: 棋喻原文的推理序列：马车换骑士（材质变而价值不变）、骑士挪位（位置变而全局重排）、一盘棋的每步同等紧要（历时变化的每步对系统都有冲击）——三步推演出语言演变的全部性质
对'棋喻溢出'的自我警告：索绪尔明确说棋子材质与语言声音不同（语言无此自由）——主动划边是方法论自觉的示范
钟表机构对照：机械零件的位置变化是外力所致，棋步是系统内的博弈——模型选择本身已成为分析问题
representative_cases_en: The chess passage's inference sequence: a carriage for a knight (material changed, value unchanged), a knight moved (position changed, board re-ranked), every move equally consequential (each diachronic change striking the system) — three steps deducing the whole nature of linguistic change

The self-warning against metaphor-overflow: Saussure explicitly marks chess-piece material unlike linguistic sound (language has not this freedom) — drawing the border oneself, a model of methodological self-awareness
The clockwork contrast: mechanical parts moved by outside force, chess moves the system's own play — the choice of model itself become an analytical question
modern_applications_zh: 商业战略类比治理：'下围棋''打仗''下棋'式类比泛滥——强制先写类比边界清单（哪里不同构）再用
系统重构沟通：用棋喻向非技术干系人解释'改一处全局重排'——位置价值的直观化
产品组合分析：每个产品线是棋子，价值=其在组合格局中的位置——砍产品先问全局重排
modern_applications_en: Governance of business-strategy analogies: the flood of 'Go-game', 'war', 'chess' talk — require the analogy's border list (where not isomorphic) before use
Communicating refactors: the chess figure explaining 'change one place, re-rank the whole' to non-technical stakeholders — positional value made intuitive
Portfolio analysis: each product line a piece, its value = its place in the portfolio pattern — cut a product only after asking the global re-ranking
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心）
维特根斯坦（对照与同代：语言游戏与棋局的类比——规则性与意义使用性的另一种哲学处理）
布莱克（后继：科学哲学中'模型'地位的正式确立——类比是有边界的推理工具，索绪尔先行的自觉）

modes.domain_zh: 知识生产方法论/从课堂口传与学生笔记重建系统性文本
modes.domain_en: Knowledge-production methodology / rebuilding a systematic text from oral teaching and students' notebooks
modes.definition_zh: 知识生产方法论/《普通语言学教程》不是索绪尔写的——是巴利与薛施蔼用三位学生（Riedlinger、Constantin、Riedlinger与Gautier的笔记）的课堂笔记在索绪尔死后两年拼合出版的；这创造了知识史上罕见的事例：一部间接著作成为学科的立法文本；方法论上可提炼的是'口传遗产的追认程序'——多源笔记的交叉校勘、编者立场的透明化、以及在'作者本意'与'文本实际效果'之间显式选择以效果为准；教训同样深刻：编者的组织框架（章节结构）部分是建构，引用时须把'教程说'与'索绪尔手稿说'分开
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-production methodology / the Cours de linguistique générale is not Saussure's writing — Bally and Sechehaye, from the notebooks of three students (Riedlinger, Constantin, Gautier), assembled and published it two years after his death; a rare case in intellectual history: an indirect work become the discipline's legislative text; the method to be distilled is a 'procedure of confirming oral legacy' — cross-collation of multiple notebooks, transparency of the editors' standpoint, and the explicit choice between 'the author's intention' and 'the text's actual effect' in favour of the effect; the lesson equally deep: the editors' organising frame (chapter structure) partly constructed, and quotation must part 'the Cours says' from 'the manuscripts say'
modes.source_chapter: 《普通语言学教程》编者序（1916）：'我们没有一件索绪尔亲手写的关于普通语言学的著作……我们冒昧地承担了这项工作'
modes.key_quote_zh: 一部作者从未署名的书成了学科宪法——口传遗产要靠交叉笔记追认，引用时把'教程说'与'作者说'分开。
modes.key_quote_en: A book its author never signed became the discipline's constitution — oral legacy confirmed through collated notebooks; in quotation, part 'the Cours says' from 'the author says'.
key_concepts: 多源校勘 multi-source collation（三位学生的独立笔记互校——差异处即编者的裁量点）
multi-source collation (three students' independent notebooks mutually checked — their divergences the editors' points of discretion)
编者透明化 editorial transparency（结构章节部分为编者建构——引用须区分层位）
editorial transparency (the chapter structure partly the editors' construction — quotation to distinguish strata)
效果优先 effect-first（以文本的历史效果而非作者本意为解释基准）
effect-first (the text's historical effect, not the author's intention, as the benchmark of interpretation)
口传遗产的脆弱性 fragility of oral legacy（讲席结束即开始损耗——追认窗口极短）
the fragility of oral legacy (decay beginning the moment the course ends — the window of recovery very short)
process_zh: 抢救源：口传内容出现后立即固定为多份独立记录——单一笔记不可靠
交叉校勘：逐段比对各源差异——差异点集中裁决
分层标注：重建文本标明'源一致的层'与'编者组织的层'
效果追认：以该文本在学科中的实际效果为最终解释基准——本意之争留作考据
process_en: Rescue the sources: once oral content exists, fix it at once in several independent records — a single notebook untrustworthy
Collate: compare the sources paragraph by paragraph — divergences adjudicated in one place
Stratify the marks: the rebuilt text labelled — 'where sources agree' against 'where the editors organised'
Confirm by effect: the text's actual effect in the discipline the final benchmark of interpretation — the quarrel of intention left to philology
representative_cases_zh: 《教程》诞生的完整链条：1907-1911 三次讲席→学生笔记→索绪尔 1913 去世→巴利/薛施蔼两年间拼合→1916 出版——每一步都可分析其增益与损耗
校勘学的实战检验：1996 年发现的索绪尔手稿（普鲁士图书馆藏笔记）让'教程说'与'手稿说'的区分落到实处——结构主义诞生神话部分改写
孔子《论语》的平行：口传语录由弟子记录整理成经——中西知识史共有'口传遗产追认'的样板，编者层皆可辨
representative_cases_en: The full chain of the Cours's birth: three courses 1907-1911, the students' notebooks, Saussure's death 1913, Bally and Sechehaye's two-year assembly, publication 1916 — each step analysable for its gain and loss

The philological test in practice: the discovery of Saussure's manuscripts in 1996 (notebooks in the Prussian library) grounding the distinction 'the Cours says' / 'the manuscripts say' — part of the structuralism birth-myth rewritten

The parallel of the Analects: an oral teaching recorded and arranged by disciples into a classic — Chinese and Western intellectual history sharing the model of confirming oral legacy, the editors' stratum discernible in both
modern_applications_zh: 技术决策记录：口头架构决策立即固定为多份独立纪要（会议记录+邮件确认+ADR）——单源不可靠
离职知识抢救：资深员工离职前启动'口传追认'——访谈录音+多份笔记+交叉校验，编者立场透明
开源项目治理：创始人未写的设计文档由社区笔记重建——重建版须标注哪些是原文哪些是社区整理
modern_applications_en: Technical decision records: an oral architecture decision fixed at once in several independent minutes (meeting notes + email confirmation + ADR) — a single source untrustworthy
Rescuing knowledge at departure: before a veteran leaves, run 'oral-legacy confirmation' — recorded interviews, several notebooks, cross-checks, the editors' standpoint transparent
Open-source governance: design docs the founder never wrote rebuilt from community notes — the rebuilt version marking what is original and what the community organised
representative_figures: 索绪尔（核心：其思想经此程序传世）
巴利与薛施蔼（操作者：编者的裁量塑造了学科的方向——重建的合法性样板）
贡布里希（对照：'图像学的口传遗产'——瓦尔堡研究院的笔记传统与追认程序的另一实例）

modes.domain_zh: 治学方法论/以一个少年时代提出的问题为终生主线持续深挖
modes.domain_en: Scholarly methodology / one problem raised in youth as a lifelong line, deepened without end
modes.definition_zh: 治学方法论/索绪尔二十岁时写下《论印欧语元音的原始系统》，提出喉音假说——半个世纪后赫梯语文献出土证实；其后一生都在这个问题引出的更深处工作：元音系统问题把他推向'系统'概念，系统概念把他推向普通语言学；方法论的提炼：真正的原创问题往往在学术生涯最早期出现，此后的事业是不断回到这个问题并换更深的层次回答——判断一个研究者是否原创，看他现在的问题是否还是他最初问题的后代
modes.definition_en: Scholarly methodology / Saussure at twenty wrote the Mémoire on the primitive system of Indo-European vowels, proposing the laryngeal hypothesis — confirmed half a century later when the Hittite tablets came to light; all his later life worked in the deeper reaches the problem opened: the vowel-system question pushing him toward the concept of the system, the concept of the system toward general linguistics; the method distilled: the truly original question tends to appear at the very start of a career, the rest of it a return to that question at ever deeper levels — whether a researcher is original is told by whether the question now is still the descendant of the first one
modes.source_chapter: 索绪尔《论印欧语元音的原始系统》(1879, 时年 21 岁) 与其后全部著作的问题连续性——从元音系统到语言系统
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个二十岁提出的问题管了一辈子：元音系统→系统→普通语言学——原创性看问题的家谱，不看论文的数量。
modes.key_quote_en: A question raised at twenty governed a lifetime: the vowel system, then the system, then general linguistics — originality read in a question's genealogy, not a paper's count.
key_concepts: 问题谱系 question genealogy（终生的著作是一个问题的连续后代——可画出家族树）
question genealogy (a life's work the continuous descendants of one question — a family tree drawable)
层次升级 level-upgrading（同一问题在更深的层次上重答——从特例到系统到元理论）
level-upgrading (the same question re-answered at a deeper level — from special case to system to metatheory)
反课题漂移 anti-drift（换领域不等于换问题——领域可变，问题主线不变）
anti-drift (changing fields not changing questions — the field may vary, the main line not)
早期原创的识别识别 early originality (recognising it early)（少年之作的价值常被低估——真正的原创问题常在约束最少时出现）
recognising early originality (the young work undervalued — the truly original question appearing when constraints are fewest)
process_zh: 找种子问题：回溯自己学术/职业起点时提出的那个问题——它现在是什么形态
画问题家谱：把后续所有工作标注为该问题的分支——断线的项目诚实标注
层次升级检查：下一个项目是否在更深层次回答老问题——若只是横向铺开则警惕漂移
换域不换问：领域迁移时显式写'这个问题在新区如何表述'——保持谱系连续
process_en: Find the seed question: trace the question posed at one's own start — what shape does it take now
Draw the genealogy: mark all later work as branches of that question — off-line projects honestly labelled
Check for level-upgrading: does the next project answer the old question more deeply — mere lateral spread a warning of drift
Change field, keep the question: on migrating, write explicitly 'how this question is stated in the new field' — the genealogy kept continuous
